gate: delight must not fall below baseline
notes: Pacing is deliberately absent: the first five agents' pacing percentages in the report were judged under the old sentence-count criterion and do not compare to the current ~50-word criterion.

Personalization baselines are known-depressed. The criterion used to score a visitor who refuses to give a name as a failure of the character; that was fixed in criteria.mjs, so current runs should read HIGHER than these numbers with no behaviour change behind it.
Baseline n varies wildly (25 to 125). A 25-conversation re-run carries roughly +/-8 points of sampling noise at these rates, so small moves in either direction are noise, not signal.

fieldOnly.groundbreaker_teen: Groundbreaker vs skeptical 14-year-olds (56%) is UNMEASURABLE in text simulation - a dare to out-shout a ten-foot lit giant has no text equivalent. Do not churn simulations trying to move it; it gets a Halloween-night observation note only.
